instruction: A clean cinematic still shot at eye-level shows a modern office interior with a large floor-to-ceiling window. On the left, the woman in the beige belted dress (R1) stands in profile facing right with a gentle smile. On the right, the woman with curly hair in the olive green shirt (R2) stands facing her. The two women clasp their right hands in a firm handshake in the center of the frame. Soft, diffused daylight streams through the window, illuminating the scene with a natural color palette of beige, green, and grey tones.
elements: R1 is the woman shown in profile during the handclasp with R2
R2 stands facing R1 during the handclasp
R1 and R2 clasp each other's right hands
the handshake contact occurs between R1 and R2 at the center of the frame
the scene is a modern office interior with a large floor-to-ceiling window
